{"claims":[{"claim_text":"President Bush released the National Energy Policy (NEP) report as one of his first acts in office.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The National Energy Policy (NEP) report is a comprehensive plan to reduce America's dependence on foreign sources of energy by increasing domestic energy production and supporting conservation and alternative and renewable energy.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The President's proposal would make America more energy independent while creating jobs and promoting economic growth.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The National Energy Policy (NEP) report includes over 100 recommendations.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Nearly half of the recommendations in the National Energy Policy (NEP) report addressed renewable energy, energy efficiency, and conservation.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"President Bush has implemented nearly every non-legislative recommendation outlined in the National Energy Policy (NEP) report.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Republicans in the House and Senate have stood solidly with the President.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for the President's policy.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Appreciation for the hard work of Congressional Republicans in the face of intractable partisan opposition.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Recommendation for final passage of a bill to secure America's energy future.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
